K&A Industries is a "secure identity architecture" company that manages the entire authentication lifecycle for government and enterprise clients. As a result, their own security weaknesses led to the compromise of sensitive personal data, biometric templates, and government contract data. K&A also provides PIV credentials to government agencies, such as the Los Alamos National Laboratory, which involves processing the personal data of federal employees. A breach of this data would trigger a cascade of legal, financial, and operational crises, leading to breach notification obligations under GDPR/government regulations, multimillion-dollar fines and class action lawsuits, loss of government contracts/CMMC status, and physical data breaches using cloned credentials at client sites.

With approximately 50 to 150 employees and estimated revenue of 20 to 50 million reais, it distributes through builders, retail chains like Leroy Merlin and its own showrooms across Brazil. The company operates its own manufacturing facility with in-house quality control and ABNT certification. Its portfolio includes decorative panels, geometric patterns, tropical designs and minimal collections alongside standard ceramic and porcelain. Key sectors are residential construction, commercial interiors and hospitality projects.

Founded by its three named partners Burgess, Lowman and Lowman, it has built a deep reputation in the Wilmington business community.

Its specializations include chillers, ducting, sprinkler systems, electrical distribution, lightning protection and marine HVAC. The company holds BCA accreditation and bizSAFE certification with ISO 9001, 14001 and 45001 standards. Projects span condominiums, office towers, factories, hospitals, schools and shipyards across Singapore. Led by founder Alan Mok, it has built a 26-year track record in Singapore's competitive M&E engineering market.

The company positions itself at the intersection of creativity and technology with a full-service model from strategy to execution. Revenue is estimated in the multi-million dollar range with regional expansion across East Africa.

In 2026 it reported net profit of KWD 10.6 million for the first 9 months with AUM reaching KWD 1.4 billion and total return of 545 percent since 2019 versus 122 percent for the Kuwait index. It executed the Trolley General Trading IPO with 15.2x oversubscription and the Ali Alghanim Sons IPO, the largest in Kuwait in over a decade. Its strategy targets becoming a leading regional investment firm by 2029 through international expansion, alternative investments and strategic global partnerships.

Sielke Papier provides a full range from printing and kraft paper to custom packaging solutions with sustainable FSC-certified options. Sielke Home offers decoration, kitchen, bath, wellness and gift products under the motto You Are Home. The company is estimated at 2 to 10 million euro in revenue with a small team of 20 to 50 employees.

gruposancristobal.com.mx Grupo San Cristóbal is a Mexican group of companies based in Mexico City, founded by Cristian Montalvo Flores, offering property management, accounting, construction, insurance and legal services across 10 plus business units. Accounting services include bookkeeping, tax filings, payroll and audits for Mexican businesses. The construction arm delivers new builds, remodeling and preventive maintenance. The group's motto is Your Happiness Is Our Business, and it continues expanding its service portfolio across Mexico.

municieneguilla.gob.pe Municipalidad Distrital de Cieneguilla is the local government of the Cieneguilla district in Lima Province, Peru, serving approximately 100,000 residents in a growing agricultural and tourism area along the Río Lurín. Led by Mayor Emilio Alberto Chávez Huaringa with 42 employees, it operates a digital services platform including virtual document submission, property tax queries, pet registration and sports facility booking. Key projects include the 2027–2029 Multi-Year Investment Plan, participatory budgeting and an inter-agency initiative to recover the Río Lurín ecosystem. The municipality promotes Cieneguilla as a natural refuge near Lima through a dedicated tourism portal showcasing local gastronomy, agriculture and outdoor activities. Transparency measures include a public accountability portal, public hearings and annual reporting to the Comptroller General. Staff grew by 162 percent as the municipality expanded digital and social inclusion programs.

darrequipment.com Revenue $304.6 Mil Darreq Equipment is a specialty equipment rental company founded in 2010 in Denver, Colorado, with a second office in Bozeman, Montana, serving the Mountain West region including Colorado, Wyoming and Montana. With 50 to 100 employees and estimated revenue of 10 to 25 million dollars, it provides mobile generators, transformers, chillers, dehumidifiers, compressors, light towers and temporary infrastructure for construction, oil and gas, mining, healthcare and data center clients. It distinguishes itself from mass-market rental companies like United Rentals by focusing on specialized high-demand equipment for complex projects. The company operates its own delivery fleet with 24/7 emergency response capability. Key sectors include large-scale construction, energy projects, disaster recovery and data center cooling. Its niche approach avoids direct competition with national rental giants while serving demanding industrial clients in the Mountain West.

resotechlaurentides.com Reso & Tech Laurentides is a Canadian industrial engineering company founded in 2001 in Saint-Jérôme, Quebec, specializing in the design and manufacture of specialized machinery, automation systems and robotic cells for automotive, aerospace, pharmaceutical and food industries. With approximately 150 employees and over 1,500 completed projects exported to more than 20 countries, it offers full-cycle services from concept design through manufacturing, commissioning and maintenance. Its capabilities span PLC and SCADA automation, industrial robotics, machine vision, test systems and custom assembly lines. The company operates from its main facility in Saint-Jérôme with commercial offices in Laval and Toronto. Revenue is estimated at 30 to 50 million dollars. Its automotive clients include major North American manufacturers while its aerospace and pharmaceutical projects demand precision engineering and sterile environments.

humboldt.ca City of Humboldt is a municipality in central Saskatchewan, Canada, founded in 1905 and named after scientist Alexander von Humboldt, with approximately 6,500 residents and a regional catchment of 30,000 people. It is the 13th city of Saskatchewan, located 117 km east of Saskatoon at the heart of the province's Iron Triangle agricultural and potash mining region. Its landmark project is a $40 million wastewater treatment facility completed in March 2026, funded $25 million by federal and provincial ICIP grants and $15 million by the city. Led by Mayor Rob Muench and outgoing City Manager Joe Day who retires in August 2026 after nearly a decade, the city employs 100 to 200 people across police, fire, water, recreation and public works. Major employers include Nutrien and BHP potash mines, Schulte Industries and Bourgault Industries agricultural manufacturers. The city runs a balanced water utility at 103 percent revenue coverage and has increased its debt limit to $20 mill.

With 116 employees and 1,000 plus platform users, it has raised 35 million dollars from General Catalyst and other investors, generating estimated revenue of 18.7 million dollars with 30 percent annual growth. Led by founder and CEO Brooke Coleman, its platform combines project databases, market intelligence, interconnection queue tracking and AI-powered predictive analytics. Clients include utilities, renewable developers, private equity, hedge funds and banks across North America. Its unique Interconnection Queue Tracker covers every major grid operator in the US and Canada. The company is based in Calgary with a second office in Toronto and competes with Enverus, Wood Mackenzie and Bloomberg NEF.

clancysystems.com Clancy Systems International is an American parking technology company founded in 1978 in Englewood, Colorado, with over 10,000 parking systems installed in more than 500 cities across the United States and Canada. Its ParkEngine cloud platform handles real-time parking management, enforcement, permits and revenue analytics. The company offers solar-powered stations, ADA-compliant units and EV charging integration alongside mobile payment options. It is one of the oldest and largest parking technology providers in North America with 48 years of continuous operation. Services span installation, maintenance, 24/7 support and consulting for municipal and private parking operators.

unitedpharmacy.sa United Pharmaceuticals Company is Saudi Arabia's third largest pharmacy chain, founded in 1990 in Jeddah by Sheikh Dr. Mohammed Al Yassin, with 450 plus branches across 80 cities and over 1,100 employees in 8 countries. It holds a 10 percent market share and targets 15 percent by 2027 through aggressive expansion, including the SAR 100 million acquisition of Kunooz Pharmacies in February 2026 and plans to open 100 new branches this year. Led by CEO Khalid Yassin since January 2024, it was awarded Great Place to Work in Saudi Arabia in 2024 and 2025. Its mobile app has 656K installs with a 4.71 star rating and offers cash on delivery, Tamara installment plans and insurance prescription dispensing. Strategic MoUs with Sudair Pharma and PPI Company aim to expand access to innovative medicines. The company competes with Nahdi (1,207 stores) and Al Dawaa (954 stores) but grows fastest among the top three.

megatrans.com.ar Megatrans S.A. is an Argentine road freight and logistics company founded in 1991 in Lanús, Buenos Aires, with 35 years of experience in general, heavy and dangerous goods transportation across Argentina and Mercosur. With over 200 employees and a fleet of 150 plus trucks, it operates regional terminals in Rosario, Córdoba, Neuquén and Mendoza with GPS-tracked vehicles. Its Esri South Africa College offers an NQF Level 6 Diploma in GISc&T and is the only Esri accredited learning center in the region. Founded in 2004 by Siva Narendra, Prabhakar Tadepalli and Tom Spitzer, under the premise “We believe in the power of the digitally connected world, but one needs digital trust for the connected world to become increasingly valuable.” We first applied this concept to the world of mobile banking transactions when smartphones were anticipated to gain traction. Our early work was done with the likes of Google, First Data, and the Department of Defense, focused on conveniently securing the identity of a digital user to enable transactions such as mobile payments. We had recognized our calling to secure online banking for the everyday consumer. Working alongside a handful of innovative credit unions (including two $10B in assets) tyfone launched our mobile banking platform. Leveraging our knowledge of convenience and user experience coupled with strong security, we relied on the expertise of our partners to bring our first iteration of mobile banking to life. A decade later, we threw the proverbial hand grenade at our “mobile only “solution and rebuilt our platform from scratch to be a modern, scalable, omnichannel solution that provides online banking services on any device, for both our retail banking customers and business banking clients. The new platform considers that user experience is critical for consumers as well as employees of our customers. Our solution envisions innovation in digital services as consumer digital interactions evolve (AI, augmented reality, virtual branches). Tyfone’s founding team members are inventors with more than 130 patents including several in financial services, that by themselves have attracted tens of million dollars in investments.
